label: C++17 + SDL2 (CMake, vcpkg)
summary: C++17, SDL2, CMake presets, vcpkg manifest, doctest for unit tests, headless smoke via SDL dummy drivers
setup_step: set VCPKG_ROOT and put CMake on PATH (docs/ENGINE.md), then: python tools/dev.py check   # first build fetches SDL2 via vcpkg (versions pinned by the baseline)

adopt_hints.CMakePresets.json: dev.py needs configure/build/test presets named debug and release with binaryDir build/<preset>.
adopt_hints.CMakeLists.txt: dev.py looks for the game exe in build/<preset>/bin/ (set CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY), and smoke runs it with --smoke N and expects BOOT_OK in its output. The kit's src/core/*.cpp (settings, saves, bindings, i18n) need a target linking nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json, and tests/test_golden_vectors.cpp needs GOLDEN_DIR="<root>/data/golden".
adopt_hints.vcpkg.json: add the kit's dependencies to yours: doctest (tests) and nlohmann-json (src/core settings, saves, i18n); keep a builtin-baseline.
